title: Quantifying the Engagement Trap: Impact of Short-form Video Recommender Systems on Users with ADHD
abstract: arXiv:2609.07795v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Short-form video platforms use recommender systems to maximize engagement through highly efficient personalized recommendations. However, the impact of these recommendations on users with ADHD compared to users without ADHD remains underexplored. Through this study, we introduce and operationalize the Engagement Trap, illustrating how recommender systems, while successfully optimizing for engagement, disproportionately disadvantage users with ADHD. This stratified study of 302 participants, recruited via the online platform Prolific, compares experiences between participants with and without ADHD. Our results show that while recommendations are perceived as relevant across groups, participants with ADHD report significantly higher levels of time blindness, post-usage regret, and emotional distress when consuming recommendations. translated_title: 量化参与陷阱：短视频推荐系统对ADHD用户的影响
translated_abstract: 短视频平台通过高效的个性化推荐，利用推荐系统来最大化用户参与度。然而，与无ADHD的用户相比，这些推荐对ADHD用户的影响仍未得到充分探索。通过这项研究，我们引入并操作化了“参与陷阱”（Engagement Trap）这一概念，说明推荐系统在成功优化参与度的同时，如何对ADHD用户造成不成比例的不利影响。这项分层研究通过在线平台Prolific招募了302名参与者，比较了有ADHD和无ADHD参与者的体验。我们的结果表明，虽然各群体都认为推荐内容是相关的，但ADHD参与者在消费推荐内容时报告了显著更高水平的时间盲视（time blindness）、使用后懊悔和情绪困扰。此外，我们还收集了针对几种面向神经多样性用户的概念验证性理论设计干预措施的反馈。
tldr: 短视频推荐系统在优化用户参与度的同时，对ADHD用户造成不成比例的负面影响，导致他们出现更严重的时间盲视、使用后懊悔和情绪困扰。
en_tdlr: Short-form video recommender systems, while successfully optimizing for engagement, disproportionately harm users with ADHD, who report significantly higher levels of time blindness, post-usage regret, and emotional distress.
